verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a REST API that manages sites and DNS programmatically, plus custom domain management with automatic HTTPS. That is first-party support for provisioning domains in code, but nothing shows it handling many customer-owned domains routed to tenants of a single SaaS app. Missing for 10: documented multi-tenant custom-domain routing (many customer domains to one app), a programmatic per-domain SSL provisioning workflow for tenant domains, domain verification or ownership flows, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can programmatically provision and route custom domains for my own multi-tenant SaaS customers

citations.quote: Manage sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically with the Netlify REST API
Simplify domain management for your projects and add unique custom domains for different versions of your project.
